newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end lower with CBR, Quick in focus.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end lower with CBR, Quick in focus.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Belgian shares closed lower after early tight trading range gave way following stronger than expected U.S. jobs data hit bonds, led to weak start on Wall Street.
* Bel-20 index .BFX down 4.62 points, 0.26 pct, at 1,765.13 points. Volume in Bel-20 around 2.2 bln Bfr.
* CBR volume leader on speculation linked to put warrant, rising 25 francs to 2,380 on trade in 289,266 shares.
* Quick biggest loser, down 175, 7.8 pct, at 2,190 francs on fears over French fast food tax proposal.
